column1: # TinyMaker partition table - MUST match the stock layout.
# The firmware keeps all print settings in the custom "eeprom" partition at
# 0x290000 (subtype 0x99). The Arduino default scheme has NO eeprom partition
# which makes EEPROM.begin() fail and every setting read back as 0. Keeping this
# file in the sketch folder forces the correct layout
# region is left untouched by a normal flash - preserves your saved settings.
